title: Hero Props: Graphic Design in Film & Television

sentences.en: When new movies come out, most of the praise goes to the director and the lead actors.
sentences.zh: 每当新电影上映，大部分赞誉都归于导演和主演。

sentences.en: But there are so many other people involved in a film.
sentences.zh: 但其实还有许多人参与了一部电影的制作。

sentences.en: And a lot of them are designers.
There are costume designers and set designers, but also graphic designers,
sentences.zh: 除了服装设计师和布景设计师，还有平面设计师，

sentences.en: working behind the scenes on all of the graphic objects that you might see in a film.
sentences.zh: 他们在幕后制作电影中你可能看到的各种平面物件。

sentences.en: And I do mean every single graphic object.
sentences.zh: 我指的确实是每一个平面物件。

sentences.en: Anything with lettering on it, anything with pattern on it,
sentences.zh: 任何带有文字的东西，任何带有图案的东西，

sentences.en: and anything with illustration on it, and most things made out of paper.
sentences.zh: 任何带有插图的东西，以及大多数纸质物件。

sentences.en: My name is Annie Atkins, and I'm a graphic designer for the film industry.
sentences.zh: 我叫安妮·阿特金斯，我是电影行业的平面设计师。

sentences.en: Over the course of her career, Atkins has designed all kinds of graphic props.
sentences.zh: 在她的职业生涯中，阿特金斯设计过各种各样的平面道具。

sentences.en: Telegrams, vintage cigarette packaging, maps, love letters, books, poems,
sentences.zh: 电报、复古香烟包装、地图、情书、书籍、诗歌，

sentences.en: any kind of chocolate box or food packaging.
sentences.zh: 以及各种巧克力盒或食品包装。

sentences.en: And with all of these objects, Atkins needs to choose or design the lettering
sentences.zh: 对于所有这些物件，阿特金斯都需要选择或设计字体，

sentences.en: and make sure the paper is just right.
sentences.zh: 并确保纸张质感恰到好处。

sentences.en: All of these small design decisions that contribute to creating a cohesive visual world for the film.
sentences.zh: 所有这些微小的设计决策，都有助于为电影创造一个连贯的视觉世界。

sentences.en: As graphic designers for film, we really have two main priorities when we start designing
sentences.zh: 作为电影平面设计师，当我们开始设计任何道具或布景时，
我们确实有两个主要优先事项。

sentences.en: The first is to set the period, and the second is to set the location,
sentences.zh: 首先是确定时代背景，其次是确定地点，

sentences.en: so that when the audience start watching the movie,
sentences.zh: 这样当观众开始看电影时，

sentences.en: they know immediately where the story is being told and when it's taking place.
sentences.zh: 他们能立即知道故事发生的地点和时间。

sentences.en: But I think the other thing that we have to do is we have to also try to tell the story at hand as well
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们还必须做的一件事是，也要尝试通过平面设计

sentences.en: So, for example, if you see a sign in the background of a New York subway scene
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你在纽约地铁场景的背景中看到一个标志，

sentences.en: you can bet any second after you see that the characters are actually going to start running.
sentences.zh: 你可以肯定，在你看到那个标志后的下一秒，角色们真的要开始跑了。

sentences.en: All the graphic design you see in a film has a job to do.
sentences.zh: 你在电影中看到的所有平面设计都有其作用。

sentences.en: Even if background signage seems to have a kind of a subliminal message,
sentences.zh: 即使背景标志似乎带有一种潜意识信息，

sentences.en: it's always put there on purpose.
sentences.zh: 它也总是被刻意放置在那里的。

sentences.en: Everything that we put in front of the camera is there for a reason.
sentences.zh: 我们放在镜头前的一切都是有原因的。

sentences.en: I met Annie Atkins at the AIGA National Design Conference,
sentences.zh: 我在AIGA全国设计大会上遇到了安妮·阿特金斯，

sentences.en: and I interviewed her on stage, and I just loved hearing her talk about her work.
sentences.zh: 我在台上采访了她，我非常喜欢听她谈论自己的工作。

sentences.en: So I asked her to come on the show and talk more about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我邀请她来节目中更深入地谈谈。

sentences.en: And today, we're just going to run part of that interview.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将播出那次采访的一部分。

sentences.en: So let's start at the beginning.
How did you get into this business?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么进入这个行业的？

sentences.en: My very first job was on a TV show called The Tudors,
sentences.zh: 我的第一份工作是在一部叫《都铎王朝》的电视剧里，

sentences.en: which we made here in Dublin and Ireland about 10 years ago now.
sentences.zh: 大约10年前，我们在都柏林和爱尔兰制作了这部剧。

sentences.en: And I went for an interview for the job as an assistant to the art department.
sentences.zh: 我去面试艺术部门助理的工作。

sentences.en: But when they saw my portfolio,
sentences.zh: 但当他们看到我的作品集时，

sentences.en: they realised I came from a graphic design background.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到我有平面设计背景。

sentences.en: They said, well, we're actually looking for a full-time graphic designer
sentences.zh: 他们说，其实我们正在为这部剧寻找一名全职平面设计师，

sentences.en: on the show to create all the graphic pieces.
sentences.zh: 来制作所有的平面物件。

sentences.en: And I couldn't understand this because it didn't make sense
sentences.zh: 我当时无法理解，因为这说不通，

sentences.en: why they would need a graphic designer on a show
sentences.zh: 为什么他们会在一部设定在平面设计师出现之前的时代剧里，

sentences.en: that was set in a period before graphic designers existed.
I'd come from this advertising background where we were making
sentences.zh: 我来自广告背景，我们当时制作的是
标志设计、网站、杂志排版，

sentences.en: and there were none of these things in the court of Henry VIII, right?
sentences.zh: 而亨利八世的宫廷里根本没有这些东西，对吧？

sentences.en: But then I learnt very quickly when I started the job
sentences.zh: 但当我开始工作后，我很快就明白了，

sentences.en: that just because there weren't any graphic designers in the 15th century
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为15世纪没有平面设计师，

sentences.en: doesn't mean there wasn't graphic designers,
sentences.zh: 并不意味着没有平面设计工作，

sentences.en: just that at that time, it would have been the craftspeople who were the designers.
sentences.zh: 只是在那个时代，担任设计师角色的会是工匠们。

sentences.en: So, for example, if Henry VIII wants to chop his wife's head off,
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，如果亨利八世想砍掉他妻子的头，

sentences.en: he's going to need a death warrant.
And if he needs a death warrant, he's going to need a calligrapher.
sentences.zh: 如果他需要死刑令，他就需要一位书法家。

sentences.en: Because at that time, it would have been the calligrapher who was responsible
sentences.zh: 因为在那个时代，负责皇家卷轴和文件的排版，

sentences.en: for the layout of the royal scrolls and documents and also the style of the lettering.
sentences.zh: 以及字体风格的，正是书法家。

sentences.en: So you become the graphic designer for the 15th century.
sentences.zh: 所以你就成了15世纪的平面设计师。

sentences.en: So now it's the graphic designer's role in film today
sentences.zh: 所以现在电影平面设计师的角色，

sentences.en: to try to imitate what the craftspeople would have done,
sentences.zh: 就是尝试模仿工匠们当时会做的事情，

sentences.en: whether that's the ironmonger or the glazier or the stonemason.
sentences.zh: 无论是铁匠、玻璃匠还是石匠。
给我们讲讲这个过程吧。

sentences.en: How do you know what your job is going to be?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道你的工作内容是什么？

sentences.en: What does it mean to be a graphic designer for a certain film?
sentences.zh: 作为某部电影的平面设计师意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, I never know what my next job is going to be.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我永远不知道我的下一份工作会是什么。

sentences.en: So I can't really prepare myself
sentences.zh: 所以我无法真正做好准备，

sentences.en: and I can't really learn every skill that I'm going to need.
sentences.zh: 也无法真正学会我可能需要的所有技能。

sentences.en: I don't know if my next job is going to be set in Victorian London
sentences.zh: 我不知道我的下一份工作是设定在维多利亚时代的伦敦，

sentences.en: or if it's going to be on a spaceship 200 years in the future.
sentences.zh: 还是设定在200年后的宇宙飞船上。

sentences.en: So what happens is I get the call.
sentences.zh: 所以情况是这样的：我接到电话，

sentences.en: I sit down with the script and I go through the script
sentences.zh: 我坐下来阅读剧本，通读剧本，

sentences.en: and I mark out anything that sounds like it might be a piece of graphic design.
sentences.zh: 并标记出任何听起来可能需要平面设计的地方。

sentences.en: And while I'm making this list, which we call a script breakdown,
sentences.zh: 在制作这份清单（我们称之为剧本拆解）的同时，

sentences.en: I'm also beginning to research the period or the genre
sentences.zh: 我也开始研究我所设计的时代、类型

sentences.en: or the storyline that I'm designing for.
I do that for about six to eight weeks prep and then shooting starts.
sentences.zh: 我会在拍摄前进行大约六到八周的准备，然后拍摄就开始了。

sentences.en: And during that time, time is always against me
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，时间总是很紧迫，

sentences.en: and I'm churning this stuff out.
sentences.zh: 我必须马不停蹄地赶工。

sentences.en: How often are you making stuff right before someone has to hold it on film?
sentences.zh: 你有多频繁需要在某人拍摄前一刻才制作好东西？

sentences.en: Well, we try to get everything made.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们尽量把一切都提前做好。

sentences.en: If it's a prop, then we try to get it made at least a week before it's shot on
sentences.zh: 如果是道具，我们尽量在拍摄前至少一周制作完成，

sentences.en: because there's inevitably going to be some changes that need to be made.
sentences.zh: 因为不可避免地会有一些需要修改的地方。

sentences.en: When I was working on the Grand Budapest Hotel,
sentences.zh: 当我在制作《布达佩斯大饭店》时，

sentences.en: I had to make a little notebook for Ralph Fiennes' character, Gustav.
sentences.zh: 我必须为拉尔夫·费因斯饰演的角色古斯塔夫制作一个小笔记本。

sentences.en: And Gustav is a very precise character.
sentences.zh: 古斯塔夫是一个非常严谨的角色。

sentences.en: And when Ralph Fiennes came in for his costume fitting,
sentences.zh: 当拉尔夫·费因斯来试装时，

sentences.en: he had his notebook and all the other props that he needed for his character.
sentences.zh: 他带着他的笔记本和角色需要的其他所有道具。

sentences.en: And he just noticed that there were no lines in the notebook.
sentences.zh: 他注意到笔记本里没有横线。

sentences.en: He'd made him a notebook with blank pages.
sentences.zh: 我给他做了一个空白页的笔记本。

sentences.en: And he questioned that because his character was so precise.
sentences.zh: 他对此提出了疑问，因为他的角色非常严谨。

sentences.en: He thought maybe it should have lines in it.
sentences.zh: 他觉得也许应该有横线。

sentences.en: So we took the prop back up to the studio and we remade the notebook
sentences.zh: 所以我们把道具带回工作室，重新制作了笔记本，

sentences.en: and we sent it back down again with lines and that was fine.
sentences.zh: 又把它送了回去，这次带了横线，这就没问题了。

sentences.en: But then after the film came out
and I started doing some magazine interviews about design and graphic props,
sentences.zh: 我开始接受一些关于设计和平面道具的杂志采访，

sentences.en: I used this as an example because I thought it was quite interesting
sentences.zh: 我把这个例子拿出来说，因为我觉得它很有趣，

sentences.en: and quite a good example of the level of detail that we actually go into.
sentences.zh: 而且是一个很好的例子，展示了我们实际投入的细节程度。

sentences.en: But of course, all the journalists heard was that I was saying
sentences.zh: 但当然，记者们听到的只是我在说

sentences.en: that Ralph Fiennes is some kind of diva.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫·费因斯是个大牌明星。

sentences.en: So I actually stopped using that as an example
sentences.zh: 所以我后来不再用这个例子了，

sentences.en: because that's not what I was saying at all, you know.
sentences.zh: 因为那根本不是我想表达的意思，你知道的。

sentences.en: It's really, it's his job to make sure that the props are right
sentences.zh: 确保道具准确是他的工作，

sentences.en: and it's our job to make sure that the props are right.
sentences.zh: 确保道具准确也是我们的工作。

sentences.en: And this is just the kind of back and forth,
the everyday back and forth that we go through
sentences.zh: 我们在为电影片场制作东西时，

sentences.en: when we're making things for a film set.
sentences.zh: 每天都要经历的来回沟通。

sentences.en: So when you're doing that script breakdown,
sentences.zh: 那么，当你进行剧本拆解时，

sentences.en: what are some of the key words that you're looking for
sentences.zh: 你寻找的关键词有哪些，

sentences.en: that indicate that you have work to do in that scene?
sentences.zh: 预示着你在那个场景中有工作要做？

sentences.en: The word that always stops me in my tracks
sentences.zh: 当我读剧本时，总是让我停下来的词

sentences.en: when I'm reading a script would be the word office
because offices are just absolutely full of paperwork.
sentences.zh: 因为办公室里绝对堆满了文书工作。

sentences.en: You know, like notice boards and filing cabinets
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如公告栏、文件柜，

sentences.en: and desks covered in all kinds of paperwork.
sentences.zh: 还有桌子上堆满了各种各样的文书。

sentences.en: So that's a huge, that's a huge set for the graphics department.
sentences.zh: 所以这对平面设计部门来说是一个巨大的布景。

sentences.en: There are lots of scenes that have a very low volume of graphics, naturally.
sentences.zh: 当然，有很多场景的平面设计需求量非常小。

sentences.en: Like, you can kind of skim read a sex scene, really.
sentences.zh: 比如，性爱场景你基本上可以略读过去。

sentences.en: Nobody ever pulls out a newspaper or starts looking at a map.
sentences.zh: 没人会在那种时候拿出报纸或开始看地图。

sentences.en: Let's talk a little bit about,
so once you get the list of things that you have to work on,
sentences.zh: 一旦你拿到需要处理的清单，

sentences.en: you begin to research what those things are,
sentences.zh: 你开始研究这些东西是什么，

sentences.en: what they're like for this film.
sentences.zh: 它们在这部电影里是什么样的。

sentences.en: And could you describe what the research is like?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下研究过程是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: So I start my research, I do a little bit of research online,
sentences.zh: 我开始研究时，会先在网上做一点调查，

sentences.en: but I find that looking things up on the internet can be misleading
sentences.zh: 但我发现上网查东西可能会产生误导，

sentences.en: First of all, nobody really ever labels anything properly online.
sentences.zh: 首先，网上从来没有人能正确地标注任何东西。

sentences.en: Like, if you find a beautiful vintage map on Tumblr,
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你在Tumblr上找到一张精美的复古地图，

sentences.en: there's absolutely no way it's going to tell you what year it's from
sentences.zh: 它绝对不会告诉你它是哪一年的，

sentences.en: or what the dimensions of it are.
And then also, it's really difficult to judge
sentences.zh: 而且，通过屏幕上的图片来判断

sentences.en: by looking at pictures on a screen,
the scale of things and also the texture of things.
So if I have to make a telegram, for example,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我必须制作一份电报，例如，

sentences.en: I really need to go to a flea market
sentences.zh: 我真的需要去跳蚤市场，

sentences.en: and find an old telegram that I can hold in my hands.
sentences.zh: 找到一份我可以拿在手里的旧电报。

sentences.en: And then I know what kind of paper to make it out of
sentences.zh: 这样我就知道该用什么样的纸来制作它，

sentences.en: and I know exactly what the measurements of it are.
sentences.zh: 也确切地知道它的尺寸是多少。

sentences.en: So I do a lot of my research in flea markets,
sentences.zh: 所以我大部分的研究都是在跳蚤市场、

sentences.en: in junk shops, buying old pieces on eBay,
raiding my grandmother's attic, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 翻我祖母的阁楼之类的东西中完成的。

sentences.en: What are some of the other tricks?
Like, so you do everything by hand
sentences.zh: 比如，你们所有东西都是手工制作的吗

sentences.en: when it would have been done by hand.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代本该手工制作的东西？

sentences.en: What does it take to make a piece of paper look old?
sentences.zh: 要让一张纸看起来有年代感需要做些什么？

sentences.en: You know, you're making it brand new and handing it to somebody.
sentences.zh: 毕竟你是在制作全新的东西，然后交给别人。

sentences.en: How do you make it seem and feel real?
sentences.zh: 你是如何让它看起来和摸起来都真实可信的？

sentences.en: The aging process for a prop is a little bit of a tricky balance.
sentences.zh: 道具的做旧过程其实是一种微妙的平衡。

sentences.en: It's a tightrope because the pieces usually
sentences.zh: 这就像走钢丝，因为这些物件通常

sentences.en: should have been brand new at the time,
sentences.zh: 在那个时代本应该是全新的，

sentences.en: at the time that the show is set in.
sentences.zh: 在影片设定的那个时代。

sentences.en: But when you're making a period drama,
a lot of the time audiences need to see a little bit of aging
sentences.zh: 观众往往需要看到一点岁月的痕迹，

sentences.en: to really believe that they're in the period.
sentences.zh: 才能真正相信他们身处那个时代。

sentences.en: You know, it's like we need to see the cracks
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我们需要看到油画画布上的裂纹，

sentences.en: in the canvas of the oil painting
sentences.zh: 因为我们在美术馆里看到的画就是那样。

sentences.en: because that's how we see it in the gallery.
sentences.zh: 我们需要纸张呈现灰白色或微微泛黄，

sentences.en: We need the paper to be off-white or slightly yellowed
sentences.zh: 因为这就是我们现在看古老文件时的样子。

sentences.en: because that's how we look at old documents now.
But if you go too far in that direction,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，一切看起来就有点像……

sentences.en: then all of a sudden everything looks a bit like,
sentences.zh: 我不知道，就像一张老海盗藏宝图，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know, like an old pirate map, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种微妙的平衡，每部戏的情况都不同。

sentences.en: So it's a tricky balance and it varies from show to show.

sentences.zh: 希望一切都呈现出一种真正的深褐色调。

sentences.en: want to go for a real kind of sepia look in everything.
sentences.zh: 而另一些导演则希望真正运用那个时代

sentences.en: And then other directors want to really work with the colours
that they would have used at the time,
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么为韦斯·安德森工作如此美妙的原因之一，

sentences.en: which is one of the reasons why it was so wonderful working for Wes Anderson
sentences.zh: 因为他真的非常拥抱那个时代的色彩。

sentences.en: because he really, like, embraced the colours of the period.
sentences.zh: 而不是采用我们制作某种年代剧时

sentences.en: And instead of doing that whole sepia tone thing
sentences.zh: 经常会用的那种全盘深褐色调。

sentences.en: that we do a lot of the time if we're working on,

sentences.zh: 我想稍后再回到《布达佩斯大饭店》和韦斯·安德森的话题，
但你还研究过其他东西吗，

sentences.en: I want to get back to Grand Budapest Hotel
sentences.zh: 你知道哪些是符合那个时代的？

sentences.en: and Wes Anderson in a second,
sentences.zh: 比如，某样东西在它本该是新的时候，确实是新的。

sentences.en: but are there other examples of things that you researched
sentences.zh: 但你需要在这种准确性与人们的期望，

sentences.en: and you know what is accurate for the time?
sentences.zh: 或者故事的预期之间取得平衡，

sentences.en: For example, something being new when it was actually new.
sentences.zh: 以至于出于某种原因，准确的呈现

sentences.en: But you're balancing that against expectations of what people want
sentences.zh: 反而不是故事所需要的那种恰当的呈现。
所以，我们为电影制作的每一个道具，

sentences.en: so that for some reason the accurate representation
